method: Independent source inspection plus controlled temporary-git/config/AST mutants. Production source was not modified by the reviewer.

findings.trigger: Replace existing baseline unit_digests or append duplicate diagnostic entries without changing source_commit.
findings.before: Set-only policy comparison accepted changed baseline metadata/counts.
findings.repair: Reviewed baseline object is immutable against a validated comparison commit.

findings.before: Global strict=true and toy negatives did not reject production-specific weakening.
findings.repair: Overrides only admit the reviewed expression-Any restriction; global strict weakening is rejected.

findings.trigger: Pass a nonexistent comparison git ref.
findings.before: git-show failure was treated as an initial baseline addition.
findings.repair: Comparison ref must resolve to an available commit before path lookup.
Additive ignores and forced exclusions are also rejected.

findings.trigger: Change an earlier duplicate-qualified function while retaining a later function with the same name.
findings.before: Last-write-wins unit hashing concealed the earlier semantic change and reused signature debt.
findings.repair: Unit digest aggregates every ordered definition sharing a qualname.

findings.trigger: Replace both import-contract source scopes by pythonstan.frontend while preserving names/counts.
findings.before: Configured contract count=2 and actual lint-imports reported 2 kept,0 broken while intended core/checker scopes were unprotected.
findings.repair: Required contract kinds/source/forbidden sets and root scan settings are checked; additional protections may expand them.

validation.reviewer_tests_quality: Ruff lint and format passed; strict mypy passed for scripts/quality and quality regression tests (10 files).
validation.negative_tool_controls: 14 controls passed; 2 integration tests passed. This suite was authored by this reviewer and still needs a separate final integrator review.

limitations: This review does not mark the parent task or G0 verified; dependencies and the final integrated whole-tree check remain the integrator responsibility.
The initial strict frontier has 13 marker/package modules. It does not establish runtime ID/Flow/Effect/ResolvedRequest adoption or the final strict core required by N4-TYPE-01/02.
Whole-tree mypy and Ruff retain explicitly recorded legacy debt. Tool exit/debt accounting is distinct from whole-tree cleanliness.
Toy type/import/archive mutants establish tool effectiveness, not production semantic soundness, certificate unforgeability, or production-wheel qualification.
Baseline migrations are deliberately rejected by the check command; any future logical-module migration needs a separate reviewed migration procedure.

final_fixture_revision_review.author: /root/quality_tools
final_fixture_revision_review.revision: CheckedSummary requires (_CheckerSeal, int). The positive fixture supplies the seal through check_summary(2); the negative supplies Candidate(3) in the seal position with the same constructor arity.
final_fixture_revision_review.assessment: The negative now tests nominal candidate-versus-checker-seal identity rather than missing-argument arity. Actual mypy emits arg-type for Candidate where _CheckerSeal is required. Python privacy still does not establish unforgeability, and this fixture does not imply production checker adoption.
